name: patstack
status: Owner-selected direction. Pack v1 built November 4, 2026. Template layouts are samples, not approved posts.
direction_selection: Owner chose the combination on November 3, 2026 from the nine candidates in studies/patstack-directions: the A1 Rack system with A3 Registration's plates as the diagram vocabulary.
lineage: SUBCULT lineage. Palette and type roles come from the selected SUBCULT C poster-press pack and the SUBCULT Visual Language; state colors come from the Omarchy subcult theme.

type_roles.display: Oswald 700, uppercase, letter-spacing 1% of size; headlines, host names, the wordmark
type_roles.body: Space Grotesk 400/500/700, sentence case; explanations and descriptions
type_roles.label: JetBrains Mono 400/700, uppercase with 8 to 12% tracking for small labels; status labels, paths, metadata, commands

rules.identity_text: violet is large-text only on the ground (4.58:1); use it for the lineage tag, the mark block and fields
rules.critical_text: use critical #ff4055 on the ground and critical_on_paper #d52032 on paper
rules.warning_text: orange carries text only on the ground; on paper it is a filled square beside an ink label
rules.texture: scanlines at 4% on posters only; documentation and interfaces stay undecorated

active.label: [ACTIVE]
active.meaning: The installed copy matches the source snapshot. Hashes, modes and symlink targets verified.

warning.label: [WARNING]
warning.meaning: An external owner (OS, Codex system or Omarchy) changed since the baseline. Listed, never written.

veto.label: [VETO]
veto.meaning: Apply refused. A destination drifted from the recorded baseline or last installed snapshot. Nothing written.

archive.label: [ARCHIVE]
archive.meaning: A retired name. Mapped to its owner in catalog/retired-names.json; no compatibility entrypoint is created.

motifs.rack_unit: ears (two 6 px squares), slot number in mono, host name in display caps, role in body, lamp (8 px square) and state label; rows 48 to 64 px; 1 px line between rows
motifs.registration_plates: three plates offset by one spacing step: installed tree (line color) at the back, plan (acid) in the middle, source tree (paper) in front; a crosshair at the front plate's top right; the plates mean hashes, modes and symlink targets agree
motifs.lineage_block: the violet block tilted 3.6 degrees appears only in the mark and on posters

hosts: public edge · Claude links not added
hosts_record: States from the 2026-10-19 fleet deployment record (docs/MARKETING-TOOLS.md in patstack), not a live readout.
canvas: https://claude.ai/artifact/L12uCteNUx37eWSZtmRFDn (private Design canvas with the nine candidates and the deeper A1 and A3 boards)
